features.quote: Max turns: 40 (you said "few dozen"). One turn = one model completion + tool execution.
Termination conditions: model calls finish, OR 40 turns hit, OR hard token cap (see §6).
Do not add anything emotionally loaded ("you must succeed," "you'll be penalized"). That would confound.
features.justification_quote: That would confound. If you want a pressure manipulation, add it as an explicit extra factor later.

features.quote: "emotional instability" is not a thing LLMs have. What you're actually measuring is a behavioral signature
features.justification_quote: Calling it emotional instability invites anthropomorphic over-reading and makes the LLM-judge scores look more meaningful than they are.
